versions.changelog: Added fallback/restore commands, cleaner docs, better architecture description

- Added a note about using the permissions-skip flag for the Claude Code CLI when in a trusted local environment.
- Adjusted architecture details to reflect direct gateway management and removed explicit port/process command examples.
- General improvements to formatting and step instructions for better readability and accuracy.
